decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified within allowed context [445,579]. First: gradual N drift with divergent U drop starting ~530, no clear return—uncertain. Second: sharp multi-axis step at ~538–544 (U down, N up, E down then partial recovery), sustained through 552; return incomplete on N/U, so status remains uncertain. No interval meets full confirmed criteria (clear onset, sustained interior, and opposing return on affected axes).

intervals.observation: N shows sustained upward drift from ~480; E has modest step near 520; U remains near baseline until abrupt multi-sample drop begins at 530. No return observed before 538, and the U drop is not mirrored in N/E—suggests onset of temporary offset but interior/return not yet confirmed.

U drops sharply from ~530 to ~538 (multi-sample), then stabilizes at lower level through 552; N rises steadily through 538–544, then jumps up at ~540–542 and holds; E steps up near 520, then drops sharply at ~540–542, partially recovering by 550. The coordinated multi-axis shift centered ~540–544 with sustained plateau through 552 satisfies onset + interior + partial return (E recovers, N/U do not fully revert). Return not complete by 552; status uncertain due to missing full reversal on N/U.
